children: AIB Data Centers disclosed an investor presentation highlighting 65 MW of contracted power under a 15-year ESA and a strengthened balance sheet with $52.8M cash.
Released investor presentation outlining strategy, pipeline and financial position under Regulation FD disclosure.
65 MW contracted power at CLT-01 under a 15-year ESA; services commence October 1.
Raised $63.3M; $52.8M cash on hand and no debt after June 2026 underwritten offering.
Q2 2026: revenue $2.9M (-39% YoY), net loss $3.5M, adjusted EBITDA $(3.1)M; gross margin (18)%.
Identified ~570 MW total capacity with ~260 MW under non-binding LOI and a ~65 MW tenant lease in active negotiation.
